parameters.jsonBody:
={{
{
  client_id: $node["get_conversation_v2"].json["client_id"],

  channel:
    $node["get_channel_identity_v2"].json["platform"],

  sender:
    $node["get_channel_identity_v2"].json["sender_id"],

  message:
    $node["Webhook"].json["body"]["message"] || "",

  direction: "outbound",

  reply_source: "human",

  conversation_id:
    $node["get_conversation_v2"].json["id"],

  message_type:
    $node["Webhook"].json["body"]["message_type"] || "text",

  media_path:
    $node["Webhook"].json["body"]["media_path"] || null,

  media_mime_type:
    $node["Webhook"].json["body"]["media_mime_type"] || null,

  media_file_name:
    $node["Webhook"].json["body"]["media_file_name"] || null,

  media_size_bytes:
    $node["Webhook"].json["body"]["media_size_bytes"] || null
}
}}
